No. 2399/27 - TUESDAY, AUGUST 27, 2024
EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
My No.: 8/3/5/3/11. Land Ministry’s Ref. No. : 4-3/18/2020/WS/249.
I hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of Land Acquisition Act, that the Government intends to acquire the land described in schedule below for a public purpose:-

Description of the Land to be acquired : Divided and defined allotment of land Marked Lot Nos. 1 to 4 depicted in Cadastral Map No. 310362 made by Surveyor General, containing in extent 0.0295 Hectares, situated at Gongawela Village (ward No. 06, Station Place, within Matale Municipal Limit) in Oyapahala Grama Niladhari Division, in Divisional Secretary’s Division in Matale in Matale District in Central Province, which said lands are bounded on :
Lot No. 01 - In extent 0.0090 Hectares claimed by Mohamed Farook Fathima Shadiya of No. 25/80/09, Oyapahala, Matale.
This Gazette Extraordinary can be downloaded from www.documents.gov.lk
(Published by Authority)
PART III — LANDS
Land Acquisition Notices

Boundaries : On North : Dekida watta, claimed by Mohamed Farook Fathima Shadiya; On East : Dekida watta, claimed by Mohamed Farook Fathima Shadiya and Mohamed Farook Tharik Haleem; On South : Dekida watta, claimed by Mohamed Farook Tharik Haleem, Lot No. 2 and Lot No. 1 of P.P. M. 703; On West : Lot No. 1 of P.P.M. 703 and roads (municipal council).
Lot No. 02 - In extent 0.0027 Hectares claimed by Mohamed Farook Tharik Haleem of Oyapahala, Matale.

Boundaries : On North : Lot No. 1 of P.P.M. 703, Lot No. 1 of this plan and Dekida watta, claimed by Mohamed Farook Fathima Shadiya; On East : Dekida watta, claimed by Mohamed Farook Fathima Shadiya and Mohamed Farook Tharik Haleem; On South : Dekida watta, claimed by Mohamed Farook Tharik Haleem and Hameed Abdul Mohamed Harisa and Lot No. 3 of this plan; On West : Lot No. 3 and Lot No. 1 of P.P.M. 703.
Lot No. 03 - In extent 0.0036 Hectares claimed by Hameed Abdul Mohamed Harisa of Godapola road, Matale.
2 A III යකොටව - ශ්‍රී ඼ංකා ප්‍රජාාාා්ත්‍රික වමාජාලාදී ජානරජායේ ි ව ශෙය඾඿ ගැවට් පත්‍රය - 2024.08.27 Part III – GAZETTE EXTRAORDINARY OF THE DEMOCRATIC SOCIALIST REPUBLIC OF SRI LANKA – 27.08.2024

Boundaries : On North : Lot No. 1 of P.P.M. 703, Lot No. 2 of this plan and Dekida watta, claimed by Mohamed Farook Tharik Haleem; On East : Dekida watta, claimed by Hameed Abdul Mohamed Harisa; On South : Dekida watta, claimed by Hameed Abdul Mohamed Harisa and Lot No. 2 of P.P.M 703; On West : Lot No. 2 and Lot No. 1 of P.P.M. 703.
Lot No. 04 - In extent 0.00142 Hectares claimed by Hameed Abdul Mohamed Harisa of Godapola Road, Matale.

Boundaries : On North : Lot No. 2 of P.P.M. 703 and Dekida watta, claimed by Abdul Razak Mohamed Harish and others; On East : Dekida watta, claimed by Abdul Razak Mohamed Harish and others; On South : Dekida watta, claimant unknown; On West : Lot Nos. 2 and 3 of P.P.M. 703.

All persons interest in the aforesaid land on which is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Matale Divisional Secretariat on 02nd day of September, 2024 at 10.00 a.m.

Further make me informed by in writing document with two copies on or before 02nd day of September, 2024 the nature of their interests in the land and particulars of their claims and compensation for the acquisition of the said land, the amount of compensation and the claims of the computation of such amount.
Kaushalya S.D. Dissanayaka, Divisional Secretary, Matale. At Matale Divisional Secretariat, 22nd July, 2024. EOG 08 - 0321
